statement: N-0073 design accepted (N0073_DESIGN.md). Warren 2026-10-07: (1) Celery beat ON as part of always-on: the existing reaper, CST expected-report slots, FX fetch and (still switch-gated) listing poll run against cip; criterion 6 'no writes' covers the supervisor and agent only, not the product's own scheduled jobs. (2) No keep-awake: the PC sleeps normally; CIP is up while the machine is awake. Engineering calls (GOV-001): the always-on API runs without --reload and is restarted by the stop script after code changes; tasks waiting in Redis are listed to Warren before the first worker start; quick tunnel is restarted only when dead, /ready failing 10 min, or public /login failing 10 min, and killed (not restarted) on positive evidence that auth is open.
